opening.argument: The video presents a concrete process for joining and funding a named trading account: its title says “How To Register And Fund Your MTI Account,” and it directs viewers to use an inviter’s referral link. It tells participants to send Bitcoin, move an activation-wallet balance into a trading pool, and submit payment confirmation, while the displayed dashboard shows an activation-wallet balance and a control to add funds to the pool. The material also requests personal details and identity proof, and displays paid, percentage-based trading results. The closing instruction to “Join now” reinforces the invitation to participate. The evidence does not establish that any transaction, payout, identity verification, or displayed result was completed or genuine.

citations.quote: How To Register And Fund Your MTI Account
Make the payment by sending the bitcoin.
If your Bitcoin is in your Activation Wallet then click on the Add Funds To Pool
